sampling_model.design: An i.i.d. observational sample augmented by deterministic public nuisance functions \((m_0,m_1,p)\), supplied global \(L^2(P_X)\) error radii bounded by \(\bar r\), a fixed signal envelope \(E_P[(g_1(X)-g_0(X))^2]\leq M\), and arm-specific conditional residual-variance bounds.
sampling_model.units: Independent units \(O_i=(Y_i,D_i,X_i)\), \(i=1,\ldots,n\), from a causal law satisfying consistency and conditional ignorability.
sampling_model.treatment: Binary treatment with propensity \(e(X)\), positive almost surely and allowed to approach zero.
sampling_model.overlap: Uniform one-sided dyadic shells satisfy \(c_-u^{\kappa}\leq P\{u/2<e(X)\leq u\}\leq c_+u^{\kappa}\) for \(0<u\leq\lambda_0\), while \(e(X)\leq1-\eta_+\). Matching converses use the stated reservoir-rich shell constants; achievability uses only the broader uniform-shell conditions.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: Every minimax rule may use \(m_0\), \(m_1\), \(p\), and the certified radii. Public inputs are fixed within each lower family. Fuzzy constructions partition only the signal reservoir into equal-mass cells, define companion cells separately, and leave background or completion atoms in the same numerical propensity bands unperturbed.

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: Theorem 1 gives a squared quantile-minimax WATE lower bound in the paper's estimator-bounded class; for constant weight, the interpretive squared-radius mapping yields \(n^{-1/2}+\max\{r_{0n},r_{1n}\}r_{en}\), while Remark 2 retains the treated-side lower-bound form with known baseline response.

Section 2 gives the lower-rate form \(n^{-1/2}+\varepsilon_n\delta_n\) for one mean functional in its pure structure-agnostic class; the attested passage supplies neither a control-arm extension, a joint two-arm ATE equivalence, nor a matching upper bound for this note's comparator class.
Thresholded AIPW is uniformly asymptotically normal under sufficient weak-overlap nuisance conditions.
IPW has Gaussian or stable limits according to tail and trimming regimes.
Extreme propensity scores generate non-Gaussian limit theory for IPW and doubly robust estimators.
Localized fuzzy hypotheses yield a minimax lower bound for pointwise CATE.
Inverse-weight estimation can have tail-dependent irregular rates.
Limited-overlap confidence accuracy is driven by local comparison-cell sizes.
Section 6.1 treats bounded-overlap ATE examples, while the conclusion identifies weak-overlap distribution shift as an open extension.

Theorem 3.1 gives asymptotic linearity and a studentized Gaussian limit for bias-corrected trimmed doubly robust estimators targeting the original treatment-effect estimand, with Proposition B.1 verifying the ATE specialization.

body.tldr: Global prediction accuracy alone does not determine attainable precision for the full-population ATE when treated observations become polynomially rare. Under reservoir-rich uniform one-sided propensity shells satisfying both \(\texttt{ass:lower-shell-richness}\) and \(\texttt{ass:upper-shell-richness}\), the public-function experiment has the matched four-channel minimax rate \(\rho_n\) for absolute risk, genuine root-MSE, fixed-probability error, and honest expected length. Only the clipped achievability and corresponding risk and interval upper bounds extend to the broader uniform-shell class without those richness restrictions. The proof uses a complete atomic law with signal-only localization, while the upper score and finite-sample fallback require only the treatment-effect signal, public approximation radii, and arm-specific residual variances. Adaptation to unknown shell and nuisance certificates remains open.

project_justification.gap: Published regular-overlap structure-agnostic results provide lower-bound templates, but the attested BonviniKennedyDukesBalakrishnan2024StructureAgnosticATE passage concerns one mean functional and supplies neither a control-arm extension nor a joint two-arm ATE theorem. Weak-overlap papers give trimming rules, irregular limits, or sufficient Wald conditions rather than this matched four-risk frontier. The accepted-bank result \(\texttt{stat\_policy\_regret\_margin\_overlap\_v1}\) studies margin-localized policy-welfare regret under coupled Tsybakov margin and one-sided-overlap decay with conditional ERM achievability assumptions. The accepted result \(\texttt{stat\_lmtp\_threshold\_atom\_frontier\_v1}\) studies an exact continuous-exposure clamp functional in finite-stratum polynomial-thinning smoothness classes with a threshold atom and causal transport. Neither accepted target or class subsumes this binary-treatment full-population ATE experiment under public global \(L^2\) certificates, and this experiment does not subsume either accepted result.
project_justification.niche: The model isolates the statistical price of knowing only global prediction-error guarantees when the treated design vanishes at a boundary. Three treated-side obstructions coexist with the regular control-side product. The primitive moment conditions are a treatment-effect signal bound and arm-specific conditional residual-variance bounds; no separate global second moment of the observed outcome or either regression is imposed.
project_justification.fill: The paper gives explicit decision classes, clipped and median estimators, a bias-aware interval, and a law-by-law four-channel converse. The converse defines a signal reservoir \(S_N\), a disjoint companion reservoir \(C_N\), dyadic background and completion atoms, and signal-only bands \(A_s^S\), \(B_s^S\), and \(B_c^S\). Regression norms and target separation use signal mass, whereas propensity errors and collision bounds use combined pair mass. Endpoint atoms in the same numerical bands stay unperturbed, and the explicit completion capacities retain the exact total-mass and fixed-sign shell proofs.

body.related_work: JinSyrgkanis2024StructureAgnosticDR, Theorem 1, gives a squared quantile-minimax WATE lower bound in its estimator-bounded class; Remark 2 retains a treated-side known-baseline form. BonviniKennedyDukesBalakrishnan2024StructureAgnosticATE, Section 2, states only that no estimator of its single mean functional \(\psi\) over its pure structure-agnostic class is faster than \(n^{-1/2}+\varepsilon_n\delta_n\); it supplies neither a control-arm extension nor a joint two-arm ATE equivalence. Dorn2025WeakOverlapTStatistics, MaSantAnnaSasakiUra2026DRWeakOverlap, MaWang2020RobustIPW, and HeilerKazak2021ExtremePropensity study limit theory, trimming, or threshold selection rather than this matched public-function minimax frontier. KennedyBalakrishnanRobinsWasserman2024MinimaxCATE supplies a fuzzy-hypothesis template for another estimand and smoothness class; KhanTamer2010Irregular explains tail-driven inverse-weight irregularity; Rothe2017RobustCI studies limited-overlap coverage under finite-cell or auxiliary structure. The accepted-bank result \(\texttt{stat\_policy\_regret\_margin\_overlap\_v1}\) concerns a margin-localized welfare target and conditional ERM assumptions, while \(\texttt{stat\_lmtp\_threshold\_atom\_frontier\_v1}\) concerns a continuous-exposure clamp functional, finite strata, polynomial thinning, a threshold atom, and causal transport. Their targets and classes are non-nested with this four-channel global-\(L^2\) full-ATE result.
body.technical_internal_limitation: The matched converse uses reservoir-rich shell constants satisfying \(\texttt{ass:lower-shell-richness}\) and \(\texttt{ass:upper-shell-richness}\); the upper bound extends to the broader uniform-shell class. The completed atomic law has explicit background, active signal, balancing-companion, and completion masses summing exactly to one. All perturbations are restricted to \(S_N\): \(B_s^S=S_N\cap\{s<e_0\leq2s\}\) and \(B_c^S=S_N\cap\{s_c<e_0\leq2s_c\}\) each contain one active dyadic level, while background and completion atoms in those numerical bands remain unperturbed. Signal mass controls regression norms and target separation; combined signal--companion mass controls propensity errors and collision probabilities. At \(\kappa=1\), exact dyadic sums replace density heuristics.
body.honest_scope: The result concerns supplied public functions, bounded certified radii, fixed shell constants, the treatment-effect signal condition, and arm-specific conditional residual variances. Every minimax rule may use all public inputs. The matched converse and honest-length lower bound have reservoir-rich shell scope; only achievability extends to all laws satisfying the broader uniform-shell condition. The interval is bias-aware and oracle-calibrated for fixed \(\alpha\in(0,1/4)\); probability-risk equivalence is for fixed \(\delta\in(0,\delta_0]\). No Wald limit or Gaussian approximation is asserted. Adaptation to unknown shell constants, tail exponent, and nuisance radii, bounded-outcome variants, arbitrary shell constants, and exact studentized validity remain open. The accepted-bank comparators are non-nested, not earlier instances of this theorem.
body.interpretation: The fast-tail regular-benchmark reduction is an algebraic check only. Bonvini's attested one-functional statement is used solely for the treated-side mapping \(\varepsilon_n=r_{1n}\), \(\delta_n=r_{en}\); no control-arm term is attributed to that source. The shell class and regular comparator class are disjoint, so no minimax equivalence or inclusion transfer follows. The accepted policy-regret and continuous-exposure clamp frontiers answer non-nested causal decision problems under non-nested law classes. Root-MSE means the square root of worst-case expected squared error, with the square inside the expectation, not worst-case absolute bias.
